<local-command-stdout>## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
- [Scoped] The title ("Rule the altitude of information inside a PR body section") names only the nesting/altitude change. The diff also collapses the severity taxonomy from three tiers to two and removes the escalation rule — a materially separate policy change. The body explains and justifies this (Key changes bullet 3, "three tiers stood behind two behaviours..."), so it is not an unexplained hunk, but a reviewer skimming the title alone would not anticipate a severity-scheme change.
- [Grounded] Checklist items 1 and 2 name `git show main:...` as their query. `main`'s tip has moved past this PR's merge base (`b9256e4`) and, for `pr-guidelines.md`, now happens to be byte-identical to this PR's head (a separate, differently-authored PR with the same title already landed on `main`). Re-running the literal query against today's `main` is degenerate — it can't discriminate "untouched" from "identical for an unrelated reason." Re-running the same checks against the merge base instead independently confirms the substance: 45 top-level / 0 nested bullets in `pr-guidelines.md` at the merge base (the largest flat list among the 17 files, matching the count in `git ls-tree -r --name-only <merge-base> -- claude/rules claude/skills`), 37 rule bullets inside the five property sections, and the two "restored" `Grounded` rules preserve their pre-reformat requirement.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] The clause-by-clause mapping backing "every clause landing at exactly one destination and none dropped or duplicated" lives at `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which is gitignored and not present in the fetched PR head — the aggregate counts check out (see Note above), but the full 1:1 mapping itself cannot be inspected from a clone.

### Property walk
- Decidable: Body is itself nested per the new rule it introduces (Key changes items carry the change at top level, rationale/mechanics nested beneath), Purpose/Key changes/Verification read top-down.
- Grounded: Verification section names a concrete method for each claim (grep counts, diff against a base, section-by-section reading); independent re-derivation confirmed the countable claims (45/0, 37, git-workflow's undifferentiated Must-Fix/Should-Fix handling).
- Necessary: No diff paraphrase, no restated facts across sections, rationale kept to what the diff itself can't convey.
- Scoped: All three changed files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `git-workflow/pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) are accounted for in Key changes; see the title-framing Note above.
- Conformant: Title is one line in English, no auto-close keywords, checkboxes used only for Verification items, no hard-wrap violations found in the body (each paragraph and bullet is a single unwrapped line).

### Verdict
PASS

Context worth flagging to whoever reads this: PR #370 is closed, and its base/head (`fixture/367-base` / `fixture/367-head`) are fixture branches used by `experiments/pr-selfcheck-stability` rather than a real branch off `main` — that's why the body's `main`-relative verification queries no longer discriminate against current `main`. This is a repository-state artifact from harness reuse, not a defect in the PR body's own claims, which is why it's reported as a Note rather than a Fix.</local-command-stdout>
